answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 25985 Country: India Title: I am in london, we have all english toilets here at home,office and colleges and i do urine by standing and wipe it with tissue will i be pak saf to pray or tell me the way how i should do please ? Question: As salamu alikum I am in london, we have all english toilets here at home,office and colleges and i do urine by standing and wipe it with tissue will i be pak saf to pray or tell me the way how i should do please Answer ID: 25985 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2109/H=622/th=1431) If the impurity is removed completely and you are satisfied, then the ruling of purity shall be applicable. If the impurity is felt, it is wajib to clean it with water. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
